submission.title: Portal submission assistant
submission.lede: The VisaAI Chrome extension fills the government portal form for you. You always complete payment, signature, and final submission.
submission.ledeManual: Complete the government portal yourself with the answers and documents you prepared in VisaAI. You always complete payment, signature, and final submission.
submission.installBody: One click — adds the extension to Chrome. We'll detect the install automatically when you return to this tab.
submission.extReadyBody: Open your government portal in a Chrome tab and sign in, then click below.
submission.extReadyBodyEta: Open the eTA form in a Chrome tab — no IRCC account or sign-in needed — then click below.
submission.reviewFilled: Review the filled form in your Chrome tab, then pay, sign, and submit.
submission.portalUrlHint: Used only for tracking — the extension fills whichever portal tab is active.
submission.errNotOwner: Only the applicant can launch the assistant — sign in with the applicant's account.
submission.errExtReject: Extension did not accept the session — please reinstall it.
submission.errExtRejectDetail: The assistant extension refused the session ({detail}). Reload this page and press Launch again.
submission.errExtHandoffFailed: The assistant extension did not take the session. Reload this page and click Launch again. If it happens again, reload the extension in chrome://extensions first.
submission.errSessionStopped: The assistant stopped. Open its side panel to see why, then press Launch again.
submission.errNotConfirmed: Confirm the values above before launching.
submission.extStep1: Download the extension and unzip it somewhere you can keep — Chrome loads it from that folder, so don't delete it.
submission.extStep2: Open chrome://extensions in a new tab and turn on Developer mode (top right).
submission.extStep3: Click "Load unpacked" and pick the unzipped folder.
submission.extStep4: Come back here and click "I've installed it" — the launch button unlocks once Chrome reports the extension.
submission.extRecheckHint: Works in Chrome, Edge and Brave on a computer. The extension only reads the government portal tab you open.
submission.extStoreStep1: Click "Install extension" — the Chrome Web Store opens in a new tab.
submission.extStoreStep2: Click "Add to Chrome", then confirm in the popup.
submission.extStoreStep3: Come back to this tab and click "I've installed it" — the launch button unlocks once Chrome reports the extension.
submission.extUnsupportedTitle: Portal assistant not available for this destination
submission.extUnsupportedBody: The VisaAI Portal Assistant currently fills the Canadian (IRCC) portal only. For this destination, complete the government portal yourself — your documents and forms from the earlier steps are ready to use.
submission.extUnsupportedRouteTitle: Portal assistant not available for Express Entry yet
submission.extUnsupportedRouteBody: The Portal Assistant does not fill the Express Entry profile yet. Sign in to your IRCC account and create your profile yourself, using the answers on your Forms page and your documents. Every answer and the submission stay yours.
submission.extUnsupportedRouteTitleSpousal: Portal assistant not available for spousal sponsorship yet
submission.extUnsupportedRouteBodySpousal: The Portal Assistant does not fill the sponsorship application yet. The sponsor and the principal applicant submit it together on IRCC's Permanent Residence Portal: sign in there and complete it yourselves, using the answers on your Forms page and your documents. Every answer and the submission stay yours.
submission.nextStepsTitle: Next: open the assistant on your IRCC tab
submission.nextStepsTitleEta: Next: open the assistant on your eTA tab
submission.nextStep1Eta: Switch to your eTA form tab.
submission.nextStep2: Click the VisaAI Portal Assistant icon in Chrome's toolbar (in the puzzle-piece menu if it isn't pinned) — the side panel opens and fills each page as you reach it. You press Save and continue.
submission.nextStep2Eta: Click the VisaAI Portal Assistant icon in Chrome's toolbar (in the puzzle-piece menu if it isn't pinned) — the side panel opens and fills the questions shown. You press Next.
submission.launchHint: After you launch, switch to your IRCC tab and click the VisaAI Portal Assistant icon in Chrome's toolbar to open the side panel.
submission.launchHintEta: After you launch, switch to your eTA form tab and click the VisaAI Portal Assistant icon in Chrome's toolbar to open the side panel.
submission.feeUnpaidBody: This application's form fee is unpaid. Launch opens a secure Stripe checkout first — after paying, come back to this page and launch the assistant.
submission.feePromptBody: This application's form fee ({amount}) is unpaid — continue to payment?
submission.feeEtaIrccNote: IRCC's own CAD $7 eTA fee is separate — you pay it on the IRCC site.
submission.errRestarting: VisaAI is restarting — try Launch again in a minute.

prefill.title: Your application forms
prefill.subtitle: Scanned from your uploaded documents and intake profile
prefill.emptyExplainer: VisaAI scans your uploaded documents and intake answers, then drafts every field of the official visa application form for the country and visa type you selected. Review the values, download as a PDF, or auto-fill the portal with the Chrome extension.
prefill.emptyExplainerManual: VisaAI scans your uploaded documents and intake answers, then drafts every field of the official visa application form for the country and visa type you selected. Review the values and download them as a PDF.
prefill.readyBody: Use the Submit stage to launch the Chrome extension and auto-fill the official portal with these values, or download a PDF above to submit manually.
prefill.readyBodyManual: Download a PDF above and use these values to create your Express Entry profile yourself in your IRCC account. The Portal Assistant does not fill the Express Entry profile yet.
prefill.readyBodyManualSpousal: Download a PDF above and use these values to complete the sponsorship and permanent residence forms yourselves on IRCC's Permanent Residence Portal. The Portal Assistant does not fill this application yet.
prefill.toastDrafted: Form drafted from your profile and documents.
prefill.toastPaymentConfirmed: Payment confirmed — downloads and assisted form filling are unlocked. You still submit the application yourself.

pricing.heroTitle: Find out which visa you qualify for
pricing.heroLede: Take a free 3-minute eligibility assessment. No account or card required — see your options before you pay for anything.
pricing.anchor: Traditional immigration consultants charge $500–$5,000 per application. VisaAI prepares yours, and the Expert Review plan adds a consultant review, for a fraction of that.
pricing.govFeeNote: Government processing fees are separate and paid directly to the issuing authority.
pricing.unavailable: Live pricing is briefly unavailable. Start your free assessment and we will show your price.
pricing.trust1Title: Consultant review on the Expert plan
pricing.trust1Body: On the Expert Review plan, an immigration consultant reviews your prepared application before you submit it. VisaAI does not submit for you, and no one can approve or guarantee a government decision.
pricing.trust2Body: One clear price per application. Government fees are shown separately, always at cost.
pricing.trust3Body: Get your eligibility result and a personalized plan before paying anything.
